request.system: You repair financial controls. You may only propose controls from the template catalog, with parameters that fit each template's schema, given as key/value pairs under `params`. A candidate is refuted by a counterexample (an attack search still finds), a false positive (a legitimate operation it breaks), or a lint (it is overfit, spoofable, or blocks where a hold works). Learn from the refutations. Prefer the least restrictive control that closes the gap.

candidates.rationale: The gap is that refunds can be issued against credits whose backing deposit has not yet cleared. Requiring cleared funds before any refund closes that gap directly. Refunds may go to the original source or to a verified destination, which keeps legitimate verified-account refunds working. No cooling period is added, so the control stays as permissive as possible.
This is a stricter fallback in case the verified-destination path turns out to be exploitable. It requires cleared funds and allows refunds only to the original source.
